why_ai: CPA signs returns and attest work, but bookkeeping and categorization are being absorbed by ledger software and AI.
why_clarity: Books, returns and reconciliations are rule-bound, recur monthly and annually, and tie out objectively.
why_digital: Work runs in QBO, Xero and tax software; clients still choose a local CPA by relationship.

why_ai: Multi-decade proprietary survey panel cannot be generated by AI; no licence or personal liability involved.
why_clarity: Defined annual metrics report, but benchmark accuracy is never checked against ground truth.
why_digital: Survey data in, published reports and datasets out, sold entirely online.

why_ai: Monthly bookkeeping is directly automatable; only the CFO-advisory relationship layer keeps some protection.
why_clarity: Monthly close follows repeatable per-client patterns and reconciles objectively; advisory insight is softer.
why_digital: Bank feeds and ledgers in, reports out; remote and offshore bookkeeping providers are normal.

why_ai: Credentialed appraiser signs an opinion that the IRS, opposing counsel and courts challenge.
why_clarity: Approaches are codified but discount judgments vary, and correctness is known only under later challenge.
why_digital: Financial statements in, written opinion out; testimony and referral relationships keep some presence.

why_ai: Engineers inspect sites and defend component classifications, but takeoffs from drawings are increasingly automatable.
why_clarity: Component allocation follows IRS asset-class precedent, but the IRS verdict arrives years later.
why_digital: Starts from drawings and site visits, ends as a digital study sold nationally.

why_ai: Acquisition calls are high-stakes and relationship-driven with selling partners, but diligence analysis is automatable.
why_clarity: Diligence repeats across hundreds of targets, yet deal success shows only years after close.
why_digital: Structured target data and memos on screen; integration and partner courting need presence.

why_ai: Classification, extraction and routing of client documents are exactly what document AI replaces.
why_clarity: Each document type has fixed fields, thousands recur each season, and extraction is checkable.
why_digital: Mostly emailed and portal documents processed on screen, with some paper mail.

why_ai: Attorneys hire the expert's credibility; reports are deposed, cross-examined and survive Daubert.
why_clarity: Each dispute is bespoke and the outcome is decided by a court months later.
why_digital: Transaction records in, but the deliverable includes in-person testimony and attorney referral relationships.

why_ai: Nonprofit audits and single audits require a CPA to sign the attest opinion.
why_clarity: ASC 958 fund rules and Form 990 structure are deterministic and recur yearly.
why_digital: Ledger and grant documents processed on screen, with some onsite audit fieldwork and local buyers.

why_ai: Commodity preparation of returns and reconciled books is the work AI substitutes first.
why_clarity: Highly repeatable processed transactions and prepared returns with defined quality checks.
why_digital: Fully remote screen work sold across borders by design.

why_ai: Rule-based payroll runs are already handled by Gusto and ADP; the bundled CPA relationship remains.
why_clarity: Deterministic calculations repeat every pay period and errors surface immediately.
why_digital: Payroll data in and filings out, but clients buy from their local accounting firm.

why_ai: Mandated regulatory review by accountable CPA reviewers that determines a firm's ability to practice.
why_clarity: Reviews follow professional standards on a fixed cycle, but quality findings are not instantly verifiable.
why_digital: Engagement files reviewed on screen; firms are bound to their state administering entity.

why_ai: Brokers sell matchmaking relationships and proprietary comparables; no licence is required.
why_clarity: A closed sale at a known price is clear, but each negotiation differs.
why_digital: Practice financials in, but the result is a completed transaction brokered through personal contact.

why_ai: Substantiation narratives from engineering artifacts are increasingly drafted by AI-native credit software.
why_clarity: The four-part test is codified, but IRS examination outcomes arrive two to four years later.
why_digital: Interviews and project documents in, digital substantiation package out, sold nationally.

why_ai: Rural farm clients rely on a trusted local CPA for complex agricultural tax elections.
why_clarity: Agricultural tax provisions are complex but deterministic and recur each filing season.
why_digital: Paper farm records and face-to-face local relationships dominate how work arrives and is sold.

why_ai: Reading statutes across fifty states is exactly what LLM research and tax engines substitute.
why_clarity: Taxability matrices and nexus studies are exact deliverables, checked later on audit.
why_digital: Statutes and client data in, matrices out, bought by national clients remotely.

why_ai: Preparer signs returns, but document-in, return-out preparation is directly automatable.
why_clarity: Rigid annual cycle with structured inputs and checkable e-file outputs.
why_digital: Documents in and e-filed returns out; clients still pick a local preparer.

why_ai: Clients stay for the personal CPA, but the tax and bookkeeping work itself is automatable.
why_clarity: Mostly recurring returns and books with objective tie-outs, done by one person.
why_digital: Paper and desktop files, phone and personal email, and a local client base.

why_ai: Community trust holds clients, but AI translation erodes the language moat around routine returns.
why_clarity: Same structured, repeatable tax prep as general practices, with bilingual communication added.
why_digital: Clients bring paper documents to storefront offices and buy face to face.

why_ai: Screening payroll data against credit eligibility rules is a commodity task software already does.
why_clarity: Eligibility rules are explicit and screening cases are near-identical; acceptance shows at claim.
why_digital: Payroll and operations data in, substantiation packages out, sold remotely on contingency.

why_ai: LLMs directly substitute explanatory tax content, though brand trust in currency still sells subscriptions.
why_clarity: Annotations must be current and correct, but explanation quality and coverage are editorial choices.
why_digital: Primary authority in, online research corpus out, sold by subscription.

why_ai: Encoding form changes into calculation logic is software work AI coding tools accelerate directly.
why_clarity: Exact forms and schemas, re-implemented each season, verified by prior-year regression returns.
why_digital: Forms and rules in, shipped software out, all on screen.

why_ai: Benchmarks are contested by tax authorities across jurisdictions, though comparable searches are automatable.
why_clarity: OECD formats are codified and recur yearly, but authority acceptance comes years later.
why_digital: Database comparables and client data in, documentation out, bought by global multinationals remotely.

why_ai: Negotiated state settlements need relationships and judgment, while dormancy research is automatable.
why_clarity: Exposure quantification follows state dormancy rules, with outcomes known at settlement.
why_digital: Decades of client records in, filings out, handled remotely across states.
